_comment: Single source of truth for embed-llamacpp integration test models. Consumed by test/integration/utils.js (ensureModel) for URL resolution + sha256/bytes integrity, and by .github/actions/cache-models for the cache key so ordinary test-JS edits no longer churn the model cache. sha256/bytes are left null until pinned from a fresh download via scripts/pin-model-manifest.mjs. Bump cacheEpoch to force a hard cache eviction.
